name: herdr
description: herdr workspace/tab/pane/agent orchestration. Parallel Claude Code + Codex workers; tunes worker model/effort by difficulty (latest-model check) with ultracode/goalcraft/goal support.

interface.longDescription: Use herdr to create isolated workspaces, split panes, spawn Claude Code or Codex workers, inject prompts, wait for agent status, and collect verification output. v0.5 adds difficulty-based autonomous tuning of each worker's model and effort (with a runtime latest-model check, no stale hardcoding), ultracode (Claude Code setting = xhigh + auto Workflow orchestration, 2-level fan-out), and goalcraft/goal usage.
defaultPrompt: Open a herdr worker pane for verification.
Read the output from a herdr pane.
